customManagers.description: ADR-0005 otterdog pin (#250): the justfile.project single source of truth plus its four in-repo mirrors, each carrying a `# renovate:` marker on the line above the literal. All five share one depName, so Renovate raises ONE pull request covering them; tests/test_otterdog_pin.py fails the build if a site loses its marker or drifts from the SSoT. Deliberately excludes otterdog.json's `otterdog-defaults` base_template pin, which is held at v0.13.1 by decision (402 on a Free plan) and is not in lockstep with this pin.

packageRules.description: The otterdog pin is proposed by Renovate and adopted by a human (#250). The engine ref selects the binary that produces every plan, so the PR requests review and never automerges. `Plan` does run on it (#230 added justfile.project to the paths filter) but is advisory, not a required check *in this repository* (ADR-0007 Axis D, #236; a consumer org decides that for itself and the only one made its plan context required — #268), so the review is where the empty-plan evidence is actually read. Note this is a requested review, not an enforced one: the `Main protection` ruleset grants OrganizationAdmin an `always` bypass, so no ruleset setting can gate the maintainer's own merge.
